To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
VoIP quality assessment is a challenging problem, because it requires the consideration of a large number of factors, such as the QoS transport network, the speech signal and the user.
the QoE assessment of VoIP service is an active research field and that a variety of methodologies and algorithms are currently available.
VoIP quality is a complex function of several factors, including network, codec and user factors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of speech quality assessment algorithms for the evaluation of the VoIP service. In particular we focus our research on the following topics
automatic assessment of Voip quality.
the development of new speech quality algorithms that can be utilized to evaluate the quality of VoIP service in a variety of scenarios.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is a lack of a standard methodology for assessing the QoE (or QoS) of VoIP service.
the assessment of the Quality of Experience (QoE) of VoIP services is an active and rapidly evolving research area.
the QoE assessment of VoIP service remains an open issue.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
this survey is the first to give a comprehensive review of VoIP QoS/QoE assessment methodologies and open issues.

we have reviewed and analyzed several methodologies for assessing the quality of VoIP service and have identified open problems that need to be addressed to achieve a robust and reliable VoIP QoEMetric.
the quality of VoIP services is not only a function of the quality of the underlying network but also a function of the service itself.
The main takeaway from our work is that
VoIP QoEM is still a challenging task.
the assessment of VoIP quality has reached a level of maturity that enables its practical utilization.
there is a need to consider the QoE assessment framework as an integral component in the development of new VoIP applications.
